verdict.rationale: The CLI and platform docs confirm delete operations exist (add, search, list, update, delete) and entity-scoped memory allows targeting by user/agent/app/session, supporting per-entity and single-memory deletion. However, evidence does not explicitly confirm a 'full erasure' bulk-delete-all-for-user endpoint, nor document deletion guarantees/verification for privacy compliance (e.g., cascading deletes, confirmation of permanent removal vs. the expiration_date feature which explicitly does NOT delete data). missing for 10: explicit bulk/full-erasure-per-user API documentation, confirmation of permanent hard-delete semantics, and independent/hands-on verification of deletion working as claimed.
